meta.quiz_name: ICAO-第四章 进近管制通话术语

questions.content: Right heading 040 until passing FL70 then direct to BK.
questions.trans: 右转航向040直到通过高度层70，然后直飞BK。

questions.content: Direct to JO, descend to FL50.
questions.trans: 直飞JO，下降到高度层50。

questions.content: Passing FL70.
questions.trans: 通过高度层70。

questions.content: Descending to 4000 feet QNH1005, expect ILS approach Runway 24.
questions.trans: 下降到4000英尺，修正海压1005，预计盲降进近，跑道24号。

questions.content: Request straight-in ILS approach Runway 24.
questions.trans: 请求直接盲降进近，跑道24号。

questions.content: Cleared straight-in ILS approach Runway 24, descend to 3000 feet, QNH1011.
questions.trans: 可以直接盲降进近，跑道24号，下降到3000英尺，修正海压1011。

questions.content: Airfield in sight, request visual approach.
questions.trans: 看见机场了，请求目视进近。 Note: 前部分也有可能读成Field in sight.

questions.content: When established on the localizer, descend on the glide path.
questions.trans: 建立好航向道后，沿下滑航径下降。

questions.content: Established on the localizer.
questions.trans: 已经建立好航向道。

questions.content: Fully established Runway 24.
questions.trans: 完全建立了，跑道24号。

questions.content: Cleared VOR-DME approach Runway 24, descending to 3000 feet QNH1007.
questions.trans: 可以VOR-DME进近，跑道24号，下降到3000英尺，修正海压1007。

questions.content: Runway in sight.
questions.trans: 看见跑道了。

questions.content: Number One, contact Tower 118.7.
questions.trans: 第一个，联系塔台118.7。

questions.content: Passing outer marker.
questions.trans: 过外指点标了。

questions.content: Report MQR outbound.
questions.trans: MQR背台报告。

questions.content: Procedure turn completed, localizer established.
questions.trans: 完成程序转弯，并建立好航向道。

questions.content: Request visual approach.
questions.trans: 请求目视进近。

questions.content: Cleared visual approach Runway 24.
questions.trans: 可以目视进近，跑道24号。

questions.content: Request holding instructions.
questions.trans: 请求等待指令。

questions.content: Hold over BKM VOR at FL100, inbound track 280 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time 1 minute.
questions.trans: 在BKMVOR台等待，高度层100，向台航迹280度，左等待，背台时间1分钟。

questions.content: Request holding procedure.
questions.trans: 请求等待程序。

questions.content: Hold on the 265 radial of BKM VOR between 25 and 30 miles DME, FL100, inbound track 085, right hand pattern, expected approach time 1022.
questions.trans: 在BKMVOR台265度径向线，DME距离25至30海里之间等待，高度层100，向台航迹085，右等待，预计进近时间1022。

questions.content: Hold at 20 DME of ST VOR, FL100, inbound track 260 degrees, left turns, limiting outbound distance 24 DME.
questions.trans: 在STVOR台DME20海里等待，高度层100，向台航迹260度，左转，限制背台距离DME24海里。

questions.content: Overhead YV, maintaining 3000 feet, entering hold.
questions.trans: 飞越YV，保持3000英尺，进入等待。

questions.content: Leaving BKM VOR heading 110.
questions.trans: 离开BKMVOR台，航向110。

questions.content: Leaving FL60, descending to 2500 feet, QNH1008.
questions.trans: 离开高度层60，下降到2500英尺，修正海压1008。

questions.content: Position 10 miles north east of LN.
questions.trans: 位置在LN东北方向，10海里。

questions.content: Turn right heading180 for base leg.
questions.trans: 右转航向180加入四边。

questions.content: Reduce to minimum approach speed, turn right heading 230,cleared for ILS approach Runway 27.
questions.trans: 减小到最小进近速度，右转航向230，可以盲降进近，跑道27号。

questions.content: No ATC speed restrictions. Contact Tower 118.9.
questions.trans: ATC没有速度限制。联系塔台118.9。

questions.content: Three sixty turn left for delay.
questions.trans: 由于延误，左转360度。

questions.content: Continue present heading, expect through the localizer for spacing.
questions.trans: 继续当前航向，由于间隔，预计穿越航向道。

questions.content: Surveillance radar approach Runway 27, maintaining 2200 feet.
questions.trans: 监视雷达进近，跑道27号，保持2200英尺。

questions.content: QNH1003, threshold elevation 196 feet.
questions.trans: 修正海压1003，入口处标高196英尺。 Note：QNH可能会读成“query normal height”。

questions.content: Precision radar approach Runway 27 heading 260, descending to 2500 feet, QNH1014.
questions.trans: 精密雷达进近，跑道27号，航向260，下降到2500英尺，修正海压1014。

questions.content: Cleared to JEMMY via BK 1A Arrival.
questions.trans: 可以经由BK-1A标准仪表进场去往JEMMY。

questions.content: Descend to reach 5000 feet by BK.
questions.trans: BK点前下降高度到5000英尺。

questions.content: When ready, descend to FL200. Report leaving FL300.
questions.trans: 准备好时，下降到高度层200。离开高度300报告。

questions.content: Descend immediately FL250.
questions.trans: 立即下降到高度250。

questions.content: Descend to altitude 12000 feet QNH 1000.
questions.trans: 下降到12000英尺，修正海压1000。

questions.content: Descend to height 2000 feet QFE 997 hectopascals.
questions.trans: 下降到场高2000英尺，场压997百帕。

questions.content: Descend to 8000 feet at 1000 feet per minute or greater.
questions.trans: 下降到8000英尺，下降率保持或大于1000英尺/分钟。

questions.content: Maintain own separation and VMC, descend to FL50.
questions.trans: 正保持自己的间隔和目视气象条件，正下降到高度层50。

questions.content: Increasing rate of climb.
questions.trans: 增加上升率。

questions.content: Unable expedite climb due weight.
questions.trans: 由于重量，不能加速上升。

questions.content: Climb to 6000 feet, follow KODAP 01 Departure.
questions.trans: 上升到6000英尺，按照KODAP-01号标准仪表离场。

questions.content: Passing altitude 2300 feet, climbing to FL80.
questions.trans: 过高度2300英尺，上升到高度层80。

questions.content: Climb to FL210, level restrictions of KODAP 01 Departure canceled.
questions.trans: 上升到高度210，取消KODAP-01号标准仪表离场的高度限制。

questions.content: Climb to FL 210, cross AU at FL100 or below.
questions.trans: 上升到高度210，飞越AU时不高于高度层100。

questions.content: Climb to FL290, level at time 55.
questions.trans: 爬升到高度290，55分改平。

questions.content: Unable FL390 by boundary, request FL330.
questions.trans: 交接点之前不能到达高度层390，请求高度层330。

questions.content: Descend to FL100, cross YU FL150 or above.
questions.trans: 下降到高度层100，飞跃YU时不低于高度层150。

questions.content: After passing North Cross, descend to FL150.
questions.trans: 过了NorthCross，下降到高度150。

questions.content: We are far above profile. Request holding.
questions.trans: 我们太高了，请求等待。

questions.content: Stop descent at 5000 feet.
questions.trans: 5000英尺停止下降。

questions.content: Expedite descent until passing FL80.
questions.trans: 加速下降通过高度层80。

questions.content: Expect descent after AK.
questions.trans: 预计过AK后下降。

questions.content: Continue approach Runway 36R, maintain visual separation with preceding traffic.
questions.trans: 继续进近，跑道36右，与前机保持目视间隔。

questions.content: Contact Control 80 miles after BK.
questions.trans: 过BK80海里处联系区调。

questions.content: Request change to London Control.
questions.trans: 请求换到伦敦管制频率。

questions.content: Monitor Tower 118.1.
questions.trans: 监听塔台频率118.1。 在部分考点，decimal会读成point

questions.content: Remain this frequency.
questions.trans: 本频率长守。

questions.content: We can see the approach lights at 200 feet.
questions.trans: 200英尺我们能看到进近灯。

questions.content: Cleared VOR approach Runway 36, followed by circling to Runway 18.
questions.trans: 可以VOR进近，跑道36号，按照航图目视盘旋，18号落地。

questions.content: Expect commencing approach at time 50.
questions.trans: 预计开始进近时间50分。

questions.content: Unable circling approach due company policy. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 由于公司政策，不能盘旋进近。请求改航。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: Request RNAV approach.
questions.trans: 请求RNAV进近。

questions.content: RNAV approach not available due FMS database. Request VOR approach.
questions.trans: 由于FMS数据库原因，RNAV不可用。请求VOR进近。

questions.content: Cleared for LDA approach Runway 24.
questions.trans: 可以航向道偏离进近，跑道24号。

questions.content: Unable RNAV due equipment, request conventional arrival.
questions.trans: 由于设备，不能RNAV进近，请求常规进场。

questions.content: Unable RNAV, loss of RAIM, request NDB approach
questions.trans: 由于RAIM丢失，不能RNAV进近，请求NDB进近。

questions.content: GPS primary lost, going around.
questions.trans: 失去GPS主用，复飞了。

questions.content: RAIM alert, going around.
questions.trans: RAIM警告，复飞了。

questions.content: Negative RNAV.
questions.trans: 不能RNAV进近。

questions.content: Proceed to AK, hold as published, expect approach clearance at 30.
questions.trans: 直飞AK，按公布许可等待，预计进近许可30分。

questions.content: Request hold for weather improvement, visibility below company minima.
questions.trans: 请求等待天气好转，能见度低于公司最低值。

questions.content: Hold at BKM VOR FL250, right hand pattern, expect further clearance at 23, landing delay at destination airport 30 minutes.
questions.trans: 在BKMVOR台等待，高度250，右等待，预计进一步许可23分，目的地机场着陆延误30分钟。

questions.content: Holding northwest of W VOR FL120, what is the delay for approach?
questions.trans: WVOR台西北等待，高度120，请问进近的延误情况。

questions.content: Request to extend the holding pattern for accomplishing the checklist.
questions.trans: 请求延长等待以完成检查单。

questions.content: Request extended holding to burn fuel to reduce the weight.
questions.trans: 请求延长等待以便消耗油减少重量。

questions.content: Cleared for CAT II ILS approach Runway 24.
questions.trans: 准许Ⅱ类盲降进近，跑道24号。 Note: CAT读为Catgory。24有可能读为“twenty four”。

questions.content: Join right hand downwind, visual approach Runway 24.
questions.trans: 加入右三边，目视进近，跑道24号。 *Note: 数字24可能会读成“twenty four”。

questions.content: Continue approach, prepare for possible go around.
questions.trans: 继续进近，做好可能复飞的准备。

questions.content: Disregard. We made the wrong transmission.
questions.trans: 指令作废。我们发错报了。

questions.content: Roger, request continue approach.
questions.trans: 明白，请求继续进近。

questions.content: Stand by. We are carrying out procedures.
questions.trans: 稍等。我们正在执行程序。

questions.content: Wilco, words twice.
questions.trans: 照办，每字发两遍。
